profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience in full-stack web development, machine learning, and software design.

I enjoy engineering - building a product that other people get real value from. I learned early on I wasn't skilled enough to build something physically, mechanical engineering was completely out of the question. Luckily for me, software engineering felt natural from the start. As my skills improved and I was able to write more complex programs, I began to realize just how many possibilities this field offers. It was here I knew I wanted to pursue a career in it. My favorite part so far has been understanding an application and business well enough that I can anticipate future customer needs and make suggestions to the team.

positions.locationName: Merrimack, New Hampshire, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Engineer in Platform Engineering for Fidelity Brokerage Technology. Our enterprise applications authorize external customer to account interactions, and manage access rights restrictions for other internal applications. Some of my specific contributions include:
- Developed a new authorization feature (for service accounts) on an application supporting a high transaction per second count.
- Supervised 3 summer interns: designed project implementation, delegated tasks, and fostered learning. The project enabled account access changes to be audited, and their output is in production today.
- Led production code installments.
- Supported our applications on a weekly on-call rotation.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: My full time experience started with a 4 month training program designed to train recent college graduates the Fidelity tech stack (LEAP). The program concluded with a project section, where I created backend functionality that enabled customers to set stock price triggers using their Amazon Alexa device. Once I was assigned to my team, my first assignment was to create web pages that allowed consumers to manage access restrictions to their applications.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
During my final 3 semesters at the University of Connecticut, I conducted astrophysics research on how turbulent particles may alter star formation in the galaxy’s central molecular zone (CMZ) in a professor-lead project.
I used the python package turbustats to analyze the turbulent properties of a section of the CMZ, and ran tests to determine which parameters have the biggest impact on turbulence.

positions.title: Intern - Software Engineer
positions.description:
During the summer of 2020, I performed full-stack web development on an enterprise application. I worked with a team that was operating under an agile methodology, so I was able to experience stories, sprints, scrum meetings, etc. My specific contributions to the project were:
- I worked on the front-end to created a menu for administrators to add alerts.
- I dockerized part of the application and learned about containers and Kubernetes.
- I worked on the back-end to add a functionality that allowed users to classify a risk level for certain actions.
- I worked with the database to create/modify tables, sequences, and triggers.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Kubernetes · Angular · Git · Web Development

positions.title: Intern - Systems Analysis
positions.locationName: Merrimack, New Hampshire, United States · On-site
positions.description:
My main responsibility for the summer of 2019 was to debug and fix previously created programs that stopped working due to a software update that caused a compatibility issue. I was able to learn how to work with other people's code, and also learn how to make my own code more resilient to these types of errors.
I also learned behavior-driven development utilizing a cucumber-serenity framework. I worked with other interns to develop automated test cases when testing a product/service.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Quality Assurance

positions.title: Intern - Systems Analysis
positions.locationName: Merrimack, New Hampshire, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Performed functional and regression testing for a project team working in an agile software
environment. Learned how to understand project requirements to develop comprehensive test cases.
Used SOAPUI to perform both manual and automated tests. Wrote groovy scripts to automate certain testing sequences.
Developed multiple software utilities using Java for internal employees. Collaborated with a coworker
in order to develop these.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Hilhorst & Zoon is a small business that creates software for back-office accounting of investments for large institutional investors. My job was to create a mobile app using Android Studio to help customers keep track of their financial investments in securities and derivatives.
